about:
# BanterCombat

**Version 1.0.0** · WoW Classic Era (`11507`) · WoW Forever classic beta (`16001`)

PvP immersion addon: kill/death banter, Dota-style announcer (First Blood, multi-kills, Ownage, streaks), rivals, chronicle, feats, and optional addon sync.

## Install

Copy `BanterCombat/` into the client `Interface\AddOns\` folder, then `/reload`.

## Announcer

| Cue | When |
|-----|------|
| First Blood | First kill of the session; again after entering a BG |
| Double / Triple / Ultra / Rampage | 2–5+ kills within 12 seconds |
| Ownage | Revenge kill, or streak 6 |
| Killing Spree … Holy Shit | Streak 3 → 10+ |

Volume and channel: `/banter config`. Custom pack: put `.ogg` files in `Sounds/MyPack/` and set the folder name in Lines options.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|----------------|
| `/banter config` | Options |
| `/banter announce` | Preview announcer cues |
| `/banter test` | Preview speech popup |
| `/banter stats` | Totals |
| `/banter hide` | Hide popup + clear queue |

## Release package

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pack-curseforge.ps1
```

Upload `dist/BanterCombat-1.0.0.zip`. Guide: [docs/CURSEFORGE.md](https://github.com/bruno-ab/wow-addon-rppvp-interactions/blob/main/docs/CURSEFORGE.md).

releases.notes:
## Polish

- Duel outcome by relative HP; cancels ignored; opponent remembered
- Compendium: stuck Contas headers fixed, empty diary/rivals, shared log lines
- Minimap menu hover; race via GUID when UnitRace is secret

`/reload` after Forever sync.

## Compendium estilo Legado

- Overview / Challenges / Counts / Rivals / Chronicle / PvP Diary
- Rich `pvpLog` + duel W–L (level, zone, map, context, self/pet)
- Race/class-gated achievements hidden when they do not apply

`/reload` after Forever sync.

## Fixes

- Menus opaque again on Forever (solid fill + BackdropTemplate when available).
- Kill popup no longer stuck invisible when fade/scale animation fails.

`/reload` after sync.

## Fixes

- Feat toast no longer repeats **Primeiro Orc** on every kill (dated feats now persist in book.when).
- Race tokens normalized (`Undead` → `Scourge`, race ids) so undead and other race feats/counters count correctly.

Reload with `/reload` after Forever sync.

## Killcam polish

- Cinematic toast: dark shade, left accent stripe, soft left cue wash
- No spaced-caps / DialogueUI parchment stack on the banner
- Hero title only for special cues (First Blood, multi-kills, etc.); banter rises when quiet
- Portrait crop + announcer-tinted ring; quieter flash and gold signature

Reload UI (\`/reload\`) after syncing Forever AddOns.
